audience: recruiters and HR teams that track candidates and job pipelines in Manatal

useCases.title: Find candidates by name, company or date
useCases.text: List candidates with filters for name, email, company, position or date range. Open one candidate to read its skills and current position.

useCases.title: Review the pipeline of a job
useCases.text: List the jobs with a status filter. List the candidates in one job's pipeline, and the pipeline stages with their ids.

useCases.title: Check candidates who applied in a period
useCases.text: List matches across all jobs with a date range. Open one match to see the candidate, the job and the stage dates.

useCases.title: Add a note to a candidate
useCases.text: List the notes of one candidate. Add a new note to the record. No tool edits or deletes notes.

useCases.title: Create a candidate and add them to a job
useCases.text: Create a candidate with a name and contact details. Then add the candidate to a job's pipeline, which creates a match.

useCases.title: Move a candidate to another pipeline stage
useCases.text: Find the match in a job's pipeline. Get the stage ids, then move the match to the new stage.
